variants.headline: Home world sends punitive expedition
variants.body: The home world has sent a punitive expedition. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.

variants.headline: An expedition with a punitive purpose
variants.body: A punitive expedition has been dispatched by the home world. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.

variants.headline: Distant authority dispatches an expedition
variants.body: The home world has dispatched an expedition intended to punish the colony. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.
